test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 18 Oct, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
The following bar graph shows the monthly profits (in lakhs ₹) of the different companies in the year 2021 and 2022. Study the diagram and answer the following question.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/20a3c58c78dbca2b82caaea7e3cfcca6b1fdfd62546bd634c3c8c131afdbe3f8.png] 

What is the ratio of the average profit earned by companies A, B, C and D in the year 2021 to the average profit earned by the companies C, D, E and F in the year 2022?
solution:
**Given:**

Profit of Company A in 2021 = ₹210 lakhs

Profit of Company B in 2021 = ₹212 lakhs

Profit of Company C in 2021 = ₹450 lakhs

Profit of Company D in 2021 = ₹340 lakhs

Profit of Company C in 2022 = ₹450 lakhs

Profit of Company D in 2022 = ₹490 lakhs

Profit of Company E in 2022 = ₹512 lakhs

Profit of Company F in 2022 = ₹398 lakhs

**Formula Used:**

Average = Sum of observations / Number
